description: The dataset title links experimental material to four named outputs about continuous-flow UV-LED reactors, immobilized titanium dioxide on porous alumina foams, DBP photocatalysis and scale-up from laboratory to pilot treatment. These titles establish a physical water-treatment process and source-defined related reports. The individual contributions of each output, internal data structure and experimental overlap with other flow-through reactor deposits remain unknown. No pilot performance or successful scale-up is inferred solely from those titles. The source authors provide these water-quality study data; geographic coverage is not stated. The source marks the data restricted while publishing CC BY 4.0 metadata. No access procedure, fee, availability date or permission to obtain the underlying files is established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Data values, archives, images and linked article or poster bodies remain unread. The reported treatment subject establishes the resource role, while measurement quality, independent sample counts and overlap with related experiments remain unverified.
